acc.summary: The schedule as printed on the listing
body: Morning: one tablespoon of the sea moss gel. Lunch or the afternoon: one or two Mag Flux capsules. Evening meal: one or two Anamu capsules. Any time in the day: one tablespoon of the Omega DHA Oil, with water or food.
At least 500 ml of spring water with the capsules, as printed. No course length is printed for the box.
They do not run out together. A 500 ml jar of gel is about 33 tablespoons. Two jars of 50 capsules are 25 to 50 days each, depending on whether you take one capsule or two.

The bottle is the odd one. This listing calls it a two month supply; the Omega DHA Oil listing calls it one month at a tablespoon a day. Both figures are printed by us, in different places, and they do not agree. We print both rather than pick.

The gel goes in the fridge, used within 28 days of opening or frozen, with a clean dry spoon. Capsules keep their lid on somewhere cool and dry, no fridge. The oil bottle prints no storage instruction of its own, so keep it closed and out of the sun.
Not for children. Not in pregnancy or while breastfeeding without asking a midwife, GP or pharmacist first: that caution sits on three of the four sheets.

If you take warfarin or any other anticoagulant, or you have surgery booked, ask before you start. Anyone with an overactive thyroid should leave the sea moss alone. Yellow dock, in Mag Flux, is high in oxalate. The oil does not state its source, so if you avoid particular oils, ring the shop before you buy.

Sent out from 599 Smithdown Road, Liverpool, Tuesday to Sunday. A box with a gel in it goes out chilled. UK delivery is free over £50, or you can collect from the shop between 10 and 6, any day except Monday.

spec.intro: Four items, four printed servings, and the one figure two of our own listings disagree about.
spec.caption: Cell Repair Kit
rows: Contents
One 500 ml jar of the Northern Soul gel. One jar of Anamu, 50 large vegan capsules. One jar of Mag Flux, 50 large vegan capsules. One bottle of Omega DHA Oil.
Price
£129.99. One size, listed with no variants.
Sold separately
£139.97 at the prices on this site: £50.00 for the 500 ml Northern Soul, plus £29.99, £39.99 and £19.99. The box is £9.98 under that.
Serving

As printed on the listing: one tablespoon of gel each morning, one or two Mag Flux capsules with lunch or an afternoon meal, one or two Anamu capsules with the evening meal, one tablespoon of Omega DHA Oil daily with water or food. At least 500 ml of spring water with the capsules.
Course length
Not printed for the box. The four items do not run out together: about 33 tablespoons in the 500 ml jar, 25 to 50 days in each capsule jar depending on whether you take one or two.
The bottle

This listing calls the Omega DHA Oil a two month supply. The Omega DHA Oil listing calls it one month at a tablespoon a day. The bottle prints no volume, so there is no third figure to settle it with. Both are printed here and neither is chosen.
Storage
Gel: refrigerate, use within 28 days of opening or freeze, clean dry spoon. Capsules and the bottle: closed, cool and dry, no fridge.
Suitable for
Adults. No vegan mark on this box, because the Omega DHA Oil listing does not state the source of the oil. The gel and both capsule jars carry one on their own sheets.
Not printed
No volume for the oil bottle. No milligram figure for the Anamu capsules. No full ingredient list for Mag Flux, which is printed as a proprietary blend. No course length for the box.
Not for

Children. Anyone with an overactive thyroid (hyperthyroidism). If you are pregnant or breastfeeding, ask your midwife, GP or pharmacist first. If you take warfarin or any other anticoagulant, or you have surgery booked, ask before you start. If you have been advised to keep oxalate down, ask first: yellow dock is high in it. If you avoid particular oils, ring the shop, because the label does not say what this one is.
spec.smallprint: Contains iodine from seaweed. Do not exceed the stated dose. Speak to your GP or pharmacist before starting any supplement, particularly if you are pregnant, breastfeeding, or take medication. Food supplements should not be used as a substitute for a varied and balanced diet and a healthy lifestyle. Keep out of reach of young children.

doctrine.h3: We publish the specification. We do not publish claims about what it does.
doctrine.p: The sheet above is four items, four printed servings, one price and a list of what nobody has printed. Cell Repair Kit is the name on the box. It is a name, not a description, and we do not expand it or say what the box is for. The live listing gives a reason for buying it that is not repeated here, because what any of these four items does in a body is not something we are permitted to tell you.

reiss.label: Reiss's turn
paras: A box implies the things in it run together, and these four do not. The gel is about 33 tablespoons. The two capsule jars are 25 days at two a day, or 50 at one, and the listing prints one or two for both, so even those two do not agree with each other. Somebody working through this box will finish one jar a fortnight before another.

The bottle is worse, and it is our own fault. This listing calls it a two month supply. The bottle's own listing calls it one month. Nobody has printed a volume, so there is no measurement that settles it, and I am not going to quietly choose the flattering one. Both figures are in the sheet above with their sources.

There is no sold separately total on this page either, because the gel comes in two jars at two prices. I could pick the 500 ml price, add it up and print a saving. I would rather send you to the four pages, where every price is printed on its own, and let you do the addition with the sizes you would actually buy.
reiss.pull: A box implies the things in it run together. These four do not.
